description: Header file defining macros and interfaces for exporting QUIC statistics, including histograms for enums, booleans, timing, and counts, used for performance and event tracking within the QUIC protocol implementation.

methods.name: QUIC_HISTOGRAM_ENUM
methods.description: Macro for defining enumeration histograms for both client and server.

methods.name: QUIC_HISTOGRAM_BOOL
methods.description: Macro for defining boolean histograms for both client and server.

methods.name: QUIC_HISTOGRAM_TIMES
methods.description: Macro for defining timing histograms for both client and server.

methods.name: QUIC_HISTOGRAM_COUNTS
methods.description: Macro for defining count histograms for both client and server.
